secondary_hierarchy_if_available.status: separate future gate; not assumed usable

record_semantics.estimated_count: retain only if Accuracy/Estimate metadata are present; uncertainty model to be frozen later before focal effects
record_semantics.count_unit: must be identical within a retained panel
record_semantics.method: must belong to one frozen compatible method family within a retained panel

macro_program_gate.decision: Proceed to prospective macro effect contract only if both minima are met before computing focal concentration outcomes.

prohibited_before_gate: select species based on decline magnitude
select MasterSites based on concentration direction
tune minimum years or component count after seeing focal outcomes
rank species or systems by focal outcome
required_audit_outputs: all species x MasterSite candidate panels
year-by-component observation matrix encoded as observed / explicit-zero / missing
eligible panel list frozen before focal effects
fallback: If fewer than 10 panels or fewer than 5 species pass, do not rescue by relaxing thresholds; keep the frozen penguin Ecology Report as the primary manuscript and close this SMP macro route.
